patches.reason: Main_DTFD_MIL.main() reads its settings only from argparse on sys.argv; the runner sets sys.argv to the original command line (pickle paths inside the output folder, --EPOCH from the case, --device cpu, --log_dir inside the output folder, case params as flags) before calling main().

testMask_dir is a module constant hard-coded to '' (to be edited by the user). The runner points it to a folder inside the output with one placeholder file per positive test slide, so reOrganize_mDATA_test labels the synthetic test bags as the original would.

Lab decision test_evaluation_coupling=patch_reference_no_test_eval: the per-epoch test evaluation (Main_DTFD_MIL.py:127-128) is skipped so it neither uses test data nor draws from the shared Python random stream. Validation calls are passed unchanged to the original function; the skipped test call returns nan, which only reaches the log line at Main_DTFD_MIL.py:145.

Lab decision reference_environment=patched_modern_torch: on torch 2.x, loss1.backward() through the retained tier-1 graph after optimizer0.step() raises an in-place modification error. The tier-2 forward is called on x.detach(); tier-2 values and gradients are unchanged, and the tier-1 gradients of loss1 that are cut were never applied (optimizer0.zero_grad() clears them before the next tier-1 step). Under torch.no_grad (evaluation) detach is a no-op.
